purpose: Feasibility/update search for an existing purposive pilot; not a completed systematic search or review.

pubmed.query: ("Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Dysplasia"[MeSH Terms] OR "arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy"[Title/Abstract] OR "arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy"[Title/Abstract] OR "arrhythmogenic left ventricular cardiomyopathy"[Title/Abstract] OR ARVC[Title/Abstract] OR (desmoplakin[Title/Abstract] AND cardiomyopath*[Title/Abstract]) OR ((PKP2[Title/Abstract] OR "plakophilin-2"[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiomyopath*[Title/Abstract] OR cardiac[Title/Abstract] OR heart*[Title/Abstract]))) AND (longitudinal[Title/Abstract] OR serial[Title/Abstract] OR progression[Title/Abstract] OR temporal[Title/Abstract] OR "time course"[Title/Abstract] OR spatial[Title/Abstract] OR regional[Title/Abstract] OR electroanatomical[Title/Abstract] OR "single cell"[Title/Abstract] OR "single nucleus"[Title/Abstract] OR proteomic*[Title/Abstract] OR metabol*[Title/Abstract] OR inflamm*[Title/Abstract] OR "hot phase"[Title/Abstract] OR "gene therapy"[Title/Abstract] OR electrogram*[Title/Abstract] OR electrical[Title/Abstract] OR transcrip*[Title/Abstract] OR calcium[Title/Abstract] OR oxidant*[Title/Abstract] OR "DNA damage"[Title/Abstract] OR "body surface"[Title/Abstract] OR outcome*[Title/Abstract] OR myocarditis[Title/Abstract]) AND ("1800/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2026/11/03"[Date - Publication])

europe_pmc.query: (TITLE_ABS:"arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy" OR TITLE_ABS:"arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy" OR TITLE_ABS:"arrhythmogenic left ventricular cardiomyopathy" OR TITLE_ABS:ARVC OR (TITLE_ABS:desmoplakin AND TITLE_ABS:cardiomyopath*) OR ((TITLE_ABS:PKP2 OR TITLE_ABS:"plakophilin-2") AND (TITLE_ABS:cardiomyopath* OR TITLE_ABS:cardiac OR TITLE_ABS:heart*))) AND (TITLE_ABS:longitudinal OR TITLE_ABS:serial OR TITLE_ABS:progression OR TITLE_ABS:temporal OR TITLE_ABS:"time course" OR TITLE_ABS:spatial OR TITLE_ABS:regional OR TITLE_ABS:electroanatomical OR TITLE_ABS:"single cell" OR TITLE_ABS:"single nucleus" OR TITLE_ABS:proteomic* OR TITLE_ABS:metabol* OR TITLE_ABS:inflamm* OR TITLE_ABS:"hot phase" OR TITLE_ABS:"gene therapy" OR TITLE_ABS:electrogram* OR TITLE_ABS:electrical OR TITLE_ABS:transcrip* OR TITLE_ABS:calcium OR TITLE_ABS:oxidant* OR TITLE_ABS:"DNA damage" OR TITLE_ABS:"body surface" OR TITLE_ABS:outcome* OR TITLE_ABS:myocarditis) AND FIRST_PDATE:[1800-01-01 TO 2026-11-03]
europe_pmc.scope_note: Europe PMC and PubMed overlap substantially. They are not treated as independent databases or independent confirmation.

planned_additional_sources: Embase or Web of Science/Scopus subject to institutional access
backward and forward citation chasing for included studies
publisher checks for early-online publications and corrections
screening_status: Not started for these search results. Existing 23 studies remain the unchanged pilot corpus.
amendment_note: After the v0.1 feasibility run retrieved 18/25 seed records, seven DOI-specific checks confirmed the missed records were PubMed-indexed. Added gene/synonym terms and electrogram, transcript, calcium, oxidant and outcome concepts. This is known-item calibration, not proof of exhaustive recall.
